name: Weeping Amber
source:
Among the willow branches, a city of mushrooms passes another quiet night. Something is ending, something else beginning.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3056720/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
柳枝间，蘑菇城又度过了一个安静的夜晚。有些事情正在结束，有些事情正在开始。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3056720/]Steam[/url]]
